quarterly_data.quarter: Santec earnings release: Q1 FY2027 Consolidated Financial Results (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (April-June 2026): net sales rose 51.2% year on year, driven by strong sales of optical measuring instruments for optical communications on expanding data-center investment.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 9,355 million (+51.2%); operating profit JPY 3,104 million (+49.4%); ordinary profit JPY 3,359 million (+79.4%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 2,709 million (+95.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Santec earnings release: Q1 FY2027 Consolidated Financial Results (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical components segment (optical monitors, filters and attenuators for optical transmission equipment makers): sales of optical monitors used in optical transceivers were firm, mainly to North America, on growing traffic from generative AI; segment profit fell on product mix and higher depreciation from capacity-expansion investment begun last year.
quarterly_data.figure: Segment sales JPY 1,388 million (+8.1%); segment profit JPY 223 million (-28.0%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Santec earnings release: Q1 FY2027 Consolidated Financial Results (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical instruments segment: optical power meters and tunable light sources for optical communications sold strongly on rising evaluation / inspection demand for faster, higher-capacity optical components; connectorized fiber-cable inspection systems stayed firm.
quarterly_data.figure: Segment sales JPY 7,381 million (+65.0%); segment profit JPY 2,818 million (+62.9%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Santec earnings release: Q1 FY2027 Consolidated Financial Results (08-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook: the company expects demand for its optical components to stay firm on traffic growth from generative AI and is strengthening production; it expects demand for fiber-cable inspection systems, tunable light sources and power meters to stay firm as production of data-center optical equipment keeps increasing, mainly in North America; industrial instrument demand is expected to recover from the second half with silicon-wafer capex. Full-year forecast unchanged.
quarterly_data.figure: FY ending March 2027 forecast: net sales JPY 37,000 million (+17.4%); operating profit JPY 12,000 million (+16.2%); profit attributable to owners of parent JPY 8,800 million (+14.8%)
